evidence.title: Icon Museum - Curated App Icon Gallery & Inspiration

name: Icon Museum
summary: Curated gallery of 247 iOS and macOS app icons, listed by app name for icon-design inspiration.
description: A curated gallery of shipped iOS and macOS app icons, browsable for inspiration. Items are listed by app name (Arc Search, Blippo, Mapkin, Sudoku A Day, Tripcache and 240+ more); an about page describes what gets featured and who is behind the museum. Pages are JavaScript-rendered, so only titles and descriptions are readable as text.
contains: iOS and macOS app icons by top designers
sample apps: Arc Search, Blippo, Mapkin, Sudoku A Day, Tripcache
